name: Modern Mil/SOF - Equipment
description: Core equipment module for a modern U.S. military / SOF simulation set. Adds kitted 'SOF' rifle variants, an LVAW in .300 BLK, modular AR uppers (12.5" GL/SSC, 16" recce, 18" Mk12 SPR), a K-length short suppressor, a grippod, collapsible/para stocks for the M240/M249 (with dedicated short variants), and a family of MOLLE battle belts. Forces/scenario content lives in a separate dependent add-on.
